people.role: Steward of the listening terrace; lights the Pine-Heart Censer at dawn and dusk
people.backstory: For forty years she has lit the dusk stick and timed the silence, and she will make a visiting envoy sit through a second stick if he speaks; Hồ Tùng Nguyệt (ho_tung_nguyet) calls her the only person in the palace the Root Hall is afraid of.

ties.note: the Incense Hall sends her the sticks

tree.intent: Long Wood sustain; outlast the noise.

people.role: Coiled Root Hall patrolman; rode the relief to the river-mouth ice in 1172
people.backstory: He led the relief that reached the Cold Ford ice two days late and found only the six sleds, and he has stood for the Root at every council since; on patrol nights he sits up with Xa Trọng Sơn (xa_trong_son) so the wine stays corked.

ties.note: he keeps him from drinking on patrol
his son, in the inner gate

tree.intent: Root holds and a palm that answers.

people.role: Dike warden of the River Hall at Đào Thanh Thành; sister of a patrolman listed as a deserter
people.backstory: Lộ Thu Hà's (lo_thu_ha) daughter, raised on the dikes, who walks the flood marks by night while her mother sings the brother whose name the palace will not sing; she will not join the Root that sent him, and she wants the order that did.

ties.note: her elder brother, dead on the ice in 1172

tree.intent: Water sustain behind a dike of Wood.

people.role: Lake Hall inner disciple who passed the Wood test by one point
people.backstory: A Hồi Lưu Thôn fisher's son who sat the Wood test four times and passed it on the fourth by a single point; he now coaches the lake children for it on the ice at Noãn Ốc and stands with Lương Tạc Băng (luong_tac_bang) for a Water gate.

tree.intent: Water first, Wood to carry it.

people.role: Array Hall inner disciple; lays the sluice wards at Đào Thanh
people.backstory: He expected to be first hand of the Array Hall and watched Cận Tùng Hàn (can_tung_han) choose Khuông Hàn Ly (khuong_han_ly) instead; he lays the River Hall's sluice wards more exactly than she does and makes sure the River Hall knows it.

ties.note: the first hand he was passed over for

people.role: Pill Room inner disciple; keeps the only chimney under the canopy
people.backstory: Raised among the herb-pickers of Bối Dược Thôn, she sweeps the Pill Room's chimney every seventh day because a spark on the canopy would end her hall, and she brews the bitter pills that Bồ Hạnh Lâm (bo_hanh_lam) will not put his name to.

people.role: Incense Hall inner disciple; rolls the sticks that time the listening
people.backstory: From Sơn Ổ Thôn like her master Lịch Hương Trầm (lich_huong_tram), she rolls every stick for the Pine-Heart Censer to the same weight, and she has noticed that the last three seasons' resin burns a breath shorter.

people.role: Fence-walker of the grey pine vein; counts Thiên Xu's surveyors
people.backstory: A Quan Hạ Thôn boy with the malachite country's Metal in him, he walks the vein's fence with Đồng Kiên Thạch (dong_kien_thach) and keeps a knotted cord for every Thiên Xu boot print he finds inside it.

people.role: Root-listener at the malachite mine; says where a gallery may be dug
people.backstory: She lies on the mine floor and listens for pine roots before any gallery is cut (A051), and she has stopped Cổ Lục Sơn (co_luc_son) twice when the richest seam ran under a living tree.

ties.note: the mine's steward, who argues with her

people.role: Granary clerk of the steward's office at Lâm Hạ Trấn
people.backstory: A grain-chandler's son of Lâm Hạ Trấn who weighs the palace's rice in and out for Từ Tích Cốc (tu_tich_coc), he votes with the River at every council because floods raise the price of what he stores.

ties.note: the resin clerk who wants his storerooms
his son, in the outer gate

people.role: Envoy's rider to Lãng Đào Môn and Tuần Tùng Đường
people.backstory: Chử Lan Giang (chu_lan_giang) sends him wherever a vassal needs to be listened to rather than answered; Giang Cửu Khúc of Lãng Đào Môn has told him three times that the sect owes her boats, and he has written it down three times.

people.role: Chants the primer to the outer gate at Tùng Hạ Thị, line by line
people.backstory: A woodcutter's son of Tiều Phu Thôn like Trình Văn Thanh (trinh_van_thanh), he has chanted the primer to ninety years of children and corrects the boy whenever he sings a line past its end, without once asking where the line came from.

ties.note: the boy who sings past the primer
outer disciple from the woodcutters' village
outer disciple; carries the censer ash down from the terrace

people.role: Keeps the Coiled Root Hall's roll of the Cold Ford families
people.backstory: Of the governor Giáp Tùng Chi's (giap_tung_chi) line, she knows by heart which Tùng Gian families came from the Cold Ford and who owns their old houses now, and she is raising her nephews on the list.

ties.note: the governor of the Cold Ford

people.role: Sluice keeper of the River Hall's lower gates at Đào Thanh Thành
people.backstory: He keeps the lower sluices and knows to the house which villages would drown first if the city's gates were held shut in a great flood; his own Thủy Xa Thôn is the third on the list, and he has told only Hoàng Đê Sinh (hoang_de_sinh).

tree.intent: Sluice wards; hold the water back.

people.role: The second voice of the spoken chronicle, learning it from Sử Trường Ngâm
people.backstory: A grave-keeper's daughter of Thủ Mộ Thôn, chosen to carry the chronicle if Sử Trường Ngâm (su_truong_ngam) dies; he has begun to leave one evening out of his recitals, and she has not yet asked which.

people.role: Outer disciple; carries the censer ash down from the terrace
people.backstory: Liễu Đình Sương's (lieu_dinh_suong) niece, who carries the ash of every listening down to the pine roots and has never once been allowed to light the stick.

people.role: Young inner disciple of the Coiled Root Hall; wants to see the Cold Ford
people.backstory: Mạnh Kiên Căn's (manh_kien_can) son, raised on the story of the empty sleds; he spars with Lạc Trường Cung (lac_truong_cung) every dawn and wants to ride with the next patrol to the river mouth.

people.role: Outer disciple of the Lake Hall with thin Wood
people.backstory: Her uncle Úc Hàm Ba (uc_ham_ba) passed the Wood test by one point, so she practises the primer twice as long as anyone at Noãn Ốc, though her Wood is twelve points short.

ties.note: outer disciple of the Lake Hall who failed the Wood test twice

people.role: Outer disciple from the reindeer herders of Tuyết Lộc
people.backstory: Bạch Lộc Sinh's (bach_loc_sinh) younger sister, who brought a reindeer calf to the Lake Hall and will not send it home.

tree.intent: Water and a beast at her side.

people.role: Ferry boy of the Đàm family at Cổ Độ
people.backstory: Đàm Tiểu Độ's (dam_tieu_do) brother, who sleeps in the bow of his aunt's ferry and wakes only to tell passengers the head once rowed it.

people.role: Young inner disciple of the Array Hall
people.backstory: He measures every ward stone twice because his master Tạ Chuẩn Thằng (ta_chuan_thang) checks three times, and he and Thạch Định Nhi (thach_dinh_nhi) race to finish the same drawings.

people.role: Outer disciple; gathers fallen-pine fungus for the Pill Room
people.backstory: From the herb-pickers' village like her master Viên Khổ Sâm (vien_kho_sam), she knows every fallen trunk in Bàn Căn Lâm that grows poria, and eats a fair share of what she picks.

people.role: Young inner disciple of the Incense Hall
people.backstory: She splits the resin for Mẫn Lục Yên's (man_luc_yen) sticks and is the one who first said the new resin smells thinner.

people.role: Outer disciple at the grey pine vein watch
people.backstory: Phí Hàn Châm's (phi_han_cham) younger brother, more Metal than Wood, who would rather fight a Thiên Xu surveyor than count his footprints.

people.role: Outer disciple at the malachite mine
people.backstory: A Thạch Tỉnh Thôn miner's son who learned to listen for roots from Đới Thạch Tâm (doi_thach_tam) and plays dice with Cổ Hôi Thiết (co_hoi_thiet) for the night shift.

people.role: Outer disciple; counts sacks at the granaries of Lâm Hạ Trấn
people.backstory: Tề Thương Mãn's (te_thuong_man) son, who counts the sacks faster than his father and sells the miscount to Tôn Mạch Sinh (ton_mach_sinh) for wine.

people.role: Young inner disciple riding the envoy's roads
people.backstory: He rides behind Hà Vọng Tân (ha_vong_tan) to the river vassals and has learned more from Lãng Đào Môn's boatmen about the Ferry War than the Hall of Voices will tell him.

people.role: Outer disciple from the woodcutters' village
people.backstory: He swears he hears nothing in the pines but wind, yet he follows Trình Văn Thanh (trinh_van_thanh), his neighbour from Tiều Phu Thôn, up the slope above Tùng Hạ Thị every night to listen.

people.role: Outer disciple; the governor's descendant
people.backstory: Giáp Tân Hồi's (giap_tan_hoi) sister, raised by her aunt on the roll of the Cold Ford families, who can recite it faster than the primer.

people.role: Outer disciple of the River Hall; runs the sluice signals
people.backstory: A Hà Đê Thôn girl like Hoàng Thủy Hộ (hoang_thuy_ho), she runs Dư Phong Ngạn's (du_phong_ngan) signal flags along the lower sluices and does not know her village is first on his list.

people.role: Young inner disciple of the Hall of Voices
people.backstory: She can chant the primer backwards, a trick Phó Tĩnh Ngôn (pho_tinh_ngon) made her stop at once, and she hears from Đoàn Tiểu Cầm (doan_tieu_cam) everything the inner gate whispers about the heir's zither.

people.role: Head cook of the palace kitchen (servant)
people.backstory: A brewer's daughter of Tửu Phường Thôn who has cooked without an open flame under the canopy for sixty years, she took in the Phượng Minh stove boy Bành Táo Nhi (banh_tao_nhi) and lets no one mock his Fire.

ties.note: the stove boy she took in

people.exception: servant (tạp dịch) of the palace kitchen: a Fire-Water root without the Wood the lineage needs (R2)

people.role: Weaves the undyed pine-bark linen for the outer gate (servant)
people.backstory: She weaves every outer disciple's bark-linen robe at Tùng Hạ Thị and knows them by their sleeves; Tuyên Bích Hà (tuyen_bich_ha) sends her the new children's measurements before their names.
people.exception: servant (tạp dịch) of the outer gate: a Metal-Earth root with no Wood or Water at 30 (R2)

people.role: Carter of fallen timber for the palace woodcarver (servant)
people.backstory: Born in a logging village that stopped felling when the palace forbade it, he hauls only trunks the wind has brought down (A059) to Lâm Điêu Bách (lam_dieu_bach), and will drive a cart a day out of his way rather than pass a fresh stump.
people.exception: servant (tạp dịch) of the palace: an Earth root with Wood under 30 (R2)

people.role: Outer disciple at the Lake Hall; dives for the pearl count
people.backstory: Born at Hàm Nguyệt Trang, she dives the beds that Phương Ngọc Sa (phuong_ngoc_sa) tallies, and keeps one pearl back from every hundred because the vassal's count never matches anyway.

ties.note: the other Hàm Nguyệt girl at the hall

people.role: Outer disciple of the Lake Hall who failed the Wood test twice
people.backstory: An ice-cutter's son of Tạc Băng Thôn who failed the inner gate's Wood test twice; Lương Tạc Băng (luong_tac_bang) means to march him to the palace for a third sitting and make the Hall of Voices watch him fail.

people.role: Young inner disciple of the Coiled Root Hall; a bowyer's son
people.backstory: A bowyer's son of Cung Tiễn Thôn, he patrols under Trần Bách Xuyên (tran_bach_xuyen) and says aloud what the Root Hall says in private, that the Cold Ford is owed.

people.role: River Hall inner disciple; the son of a patrolman whose name is not sung
people.backstory: Lộ Thanh Xuyên's (lo_thanh_xuyen) son, three when the patrol went onto the ice, he refused the Coiled Root Hall that sent his father and works the dikes under his aunt, singing his father's name under his breath at the dusk listening.

tree.intent: Wood with the river in it.

people.role: Outer disciple; carries letters at the Tùng Hạ Thị market
people.backstory: A market girl who carries Phù Liên Châu's (phu_lien_chau) sealed letters to the palace for a copper each and has never wondered why the seals are the Root Hall's.

people.role: The newest outer disciple, from Thanh Tùng Thôn
people.backstory: Tested this spring at sixteen, he has already challenged Địch Tiểu Hổ (dich_tieu_ho), the other Thanh Tùng boy, and lost, and challenged him again.

people.role: Young inner disciple of the Pill Room; stokes the chimney furnace
people.backstory: She stokes the one furnace with a chimney and wants the second furnace that Đàm Thanh Giang (dam_thanh_giang) heals at; Viên Khổ Sâm (vien_kho_sam) makes her sweep the flue first.

people.role: Outer disciple; the woodcarver's second apprentice
people.backstory: From Phạt Mộc Thôn, the logging village that put down its saws, he carves only fallen wood for Lâm Điêu Bách (lam_dieu_bach) and lets Lâm Thanh Mộc (lam_thanh_moc) take the credit.

people.role: Outer disciple; carries the palace's letters to the vassals
people.backstory: A boat-builder's son of Lâu Thuyền Trấn who carries Tống Ngôn Hòa's (tong_ngon_hoa) satchel to Sương Tùng Các and back and has never been told what the letters say.

people.role: Old outer disciple; weighs resin at Tùng Gian Thành
people.backstory: He sat the Wood test five times between 1130 and 1150 and gave up at forty; he has weighed the resin tithe for Hầu Thiện Kế (hau_thien_ke) ever since and lends the young clerks money.

people.role: Outer disciple of the Lake Hall; spots Băng Tâm's skiffs
people.backstory: A north-shore boy descended from Chiêm Hậu Đức (chiem_hau_duc), the first steward of the north, he counts Băng Tâm's skiffs from the Bắc Ngạn cliffs for Thiều Lăng Ba (thieu_lang_ba).

ties.note: the first steward of the north
